title: Bond connection should offer MTU setting like wired Ethernet
line: Bond connections now have an MTU field in their Bond tab, and an MTU set elsewhere is kept when the bond is saved.
explanation: NetworkManager stores a bond's MTU in the bond connection's 802-3-ethernet setting, but NetworkManagerQt's bond connection type didn't include that setting, so it was dropped when a bond was read, and plasma-nm's Bond tab had no MTU field at all. Saving a bond from the editor therefore also sent no Ethernet setting, which would wipe an MTU set with nmcli. NetworkManagerQt now includes the Ethernet setting in bond connections, and the Bond tab gets an MTU spin box (same tooltip, range and "Automatic" value as the Wired tab) under the interface name, saved into that Ethernet setting while keeping its other values.

commits.message:
settings: keep the Ethernet setting of bond connections

NetworkManager keeps a bond's MTU and cloned MAC address in its Ethernet
setting, but bond connections didn't include it, so it was ignored when
reading a bond and lost when saving it back. Add it to bond connections.

BUG: 470148

editor/bond: add an MTU setting

Bond connections had no MTU field, so a bond stayed at 1500 bytes even
when its ports used jumbo frames. Add one below the interface name, like
the Wired tab has, stored in the bond's Ethernet setting as NM expects.

BUG: 470148

             settings.insert(type, widget->setting());
         }
 
+        if (type == NetworkManager::Setting::typeAsString(NetworkManager::Setting::Bond)) {
+            const QVariantMap wiredSetting = static_cast<BondWidget *>(widget)->wiredSetting();
+            if (!wiredSetting.isEmpty()) {
+                settings.insert(NetworkManager::Setting::typeAsString(NetworkManager::Setting::Wired), wiredSetting);
+            }
+        }
+

         QVariantMap security8021x;

@@ -288,7 +295,11 @@ void ConnectionEditorBase::initialize()
         auto infinibandWidget = new InfinibandWidget(m_connection->setting(NetworkManager::Setting::Infiniband), this);
         addSettingWidget(infinibandWidget, i18n("Infiniband"));
     } else if (type == NetworkManager::ConnectionSettings::Bond) { // Bond
-        auto bondWidget = new BondWidget(m_connection->uuid(), m_connection->id(), m_connection->setting(NetworkManager::Setting::Bond), this);
+        auto bondWidget = new BondWidget(m_connection->uuid(),
+                                         m_connection->id(),
+                                         m_connection->setting(NetworkManager::Setting::Bond),
+                                         m_connection->setting(NetworkManager::Setting::Wired),
+                                         this);
         addSettingWidget(bondWidget, i18n("Bond"));
     } else if (type == NetworkManager::ConnectionSettings::Bridge) { // Bridge
         auto bridgeWidget = new BridgeWidget(m_connection->uuid(), m_connection->id(), m_connection->setting(NetworkManager::Setting::Bridge), this);

+                       QWidget *parent,

@@ -75,6 +80,11 @@ BondWidget::BondWidget(const QString &masterUuid, const QString &masterId, const
     if (setting) {
         loadConfig(setting);
     }
+
+    if (wiredSetting && !wiredSetting->isNull()) {
+        m_wiredSetting = wiredSetting.staticCast<NetworkManager::WiredSetting>();
+        m_ui->mtu->setValue(m_wiredSetting->mtu());
+    }
 }
 
 BondWidget::~BondWidget()
@@ -153,6 +163,17 @@ QVariantMap BondWidget::setting() const
     return setting.toMap();
 }
 
+QVariantMap BondWidget::wiredSetting() const
+{
+    if (!m_wiredSetting && !m_ui->mtu->value()) {
+        return {};
+    }
+
+    NetworkManager::WiredSetting::Ptr setting(m_wiredSetting ? new NetworkManager::WiredSetting(m_wiredSetting) : new NetworkManager::WiredSetting);
+    setting->setMtu(m_ui->mtu->value());
+    return setting->toMap();
+}
+
 void BondWidget::addBond(QAction *action)
 {
     qCDebug(PLASMA_NM_EDITOR_LOG) << "Adding bonded connection:" << action->data();
